title: 链计数与校验和实际范围压缩
invariants: CHAIN_SETUP keeps 8-bit endpoint_count and rejects zero or values above67 before rolling
pipe_next_chain/pipe_completed are reset and only increase up to accepted endpoint_count<=67
slot chain indices are issued before pipe_next_chain reaches endpoint_count
TRANSFORM reads 32/48/64 message digits; index is always0..63 and checksum<=15*64=960
scope: All supported standard profiles and accepted chain counts 1..67; external widths/error checks retained; no state/handshake/cycle change
risks: Range proof must match actual consumers and reset/replay; register-width reduction need not lower area
